commands.name: a2a
commands.output:
Usage:
  /a2a add <url> [alias] [--token-setting | --token-cmd "<command>" | --token-file <path>] [--trust-endpoint]
      (re-run to refresh; with no token flag the token comes from the tokens setting)
  /a2a list
  /a2a remove <alias>

Never type a token here: slash commands are kept in the transcript.

tools.name: workers
tools.description: List the A2A worker agents the user registered, with their skills. Call before send to pick a worker.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a task to an A2A worker agent. Returns the answer if it finishes within a few seconds; otherwise returns a task id, and you get a message when it finishes. Do not poll. Pass taskId to answer a worker that asked for input, contextId to continue a conversation.

tools.name: task
tools.description: Get the state and full result of an A2A task, or cancel it.

tools.name: add_worker
tools.description: Register an A2A worker from its URL. The user is asked to approve it first. Tokens set by command or file, and --trust-endpoint, need the user to run /a2a add themselves.

tools.name: remove_worker
tools.description: Forget a registered A2A worker. The user is asked to approve it first.
